title: BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers
authors: J. Devlin, M. Chang, K. Lee, K. Toutanova
before: Pretrained language models read left to right, because prediction requires it.
problem: For understanding tasks, the words after a position matter as much as those before.
breakthrough: Mask random tokens and predict them from both directions, so every layer sees full context. GLUE rose to 80.5.
why: It dominated NLP for three years and still powers embeddings and retrieval, even though generation went the other way.
next: RoBERTa tuned the recipe; the encoder line fed Sentence-BERT, DPR and modern retrieval.
inherits: The encoder half of the field: embeddings, rerankers, classifiers.
